moments.author: A24
moments.quote: You see how this looks, right? Lance Oppenheim's PRIMETIME produced by and starring Robert Pattinson as famed To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen, inspired by true events. Have a seat September 25.

moments.author: Rosy Cordero (Deadline via Yahoo)
moments.quote: “So to have Cristo’s sister Paloma on the show, who we had all known personally… the two of them are just a joy to be around. And that joy remains with them as individuals.”
moments.why: It stood out for highlighting the heartfelt behind‑the‑scenes connection that added warmth to the new season of Ted Lasso.
